description: Seed historical incidents for route-history feature. Individual incidents are source-backed; district summaries are aggregate context and must not be counted as individual incidents.

incidents.title: Two youths killed in motorcycle and bullock-cart collision
incidents.locationName: Mundhal, Bodi-Munnar Highway, near Bodinayakanur, Theni
incidents.description: A motorcycle struck a bullock cart from behind on the Bodi-Munnar highway near Mundhal. Two youths died.

incidents.title: Car and motorcycle collision near Old Government College
incidents.locationName: Old Government College area, Munnar, Kochi-Dhanushkodi National Highway
incidents.description: A motorcycle collided with a car near the Old Government College area on the Kochi-Dhanushkodi National Highway. The motorcyclist suffered serious injuries.

incidents.title: Car and lorry collision near Amaravathi
incidents.description: A car carrying tourists collided with a lorry near Amaravathi AKG Padi on the Kumily-Munnar road. Two people were injured.

incidents.title: Jeep accident on Kumily-Munnar Road
incidents.description: A jeep accident occurred on the Kumily-Munnar road at Kalkoonthal; a passenger sustained fatal injuries.

incidents.title: Jeep and bus collision
incidents.locationName: Nallakaruppanpatti, Periyakulam-Batlagundu Main Road, Theni region
incidents.description: A jeep belonging to Theni Allinagaram Municipality collided with a bus near Nallakaruppanpatti on the Periyakulam-Batlagundu Main Road. The jeep occupants suffered grievous injuries.

incidents.title: Car and truck head-on collision
incidents.description: A car collided head-on with a truck near Sithaiyankottai/Sempatti in Dindigul district. Two people died at the scene.

incidents.title: Large boulders blocked Bodi Mettu Ghat Road
incidents.locationName: Bodi Mettu Ghat Road, 107th km of Madurai-Cochin NH-49, Theni
incidents.description: Overnight rockslides dropped large boulders onto Bodi Mettu Ghat Road and blocked interstate traffic. No major accident was reported because vehicular movement was limited during the COVID lockdown.

incidents.title: Pettimudi landslide
incidents.description: A major landslide occurred at Pettimudi, Munnar. The India Meteorological Department recorded 65 deaths in the event and major road/bridge disruption in the area.
incidents.sourceName: India Meteorological Department, Disastrous Weather Events 2020

incidents.title: Landslide on Munnar Ghat Road
incidents.description: Kerala State Planning Board's field report records a 2019 landslide on Munnar Ghat Road 1; the report notes two casualties and a series of landslides associated with road widening activity.
incidents.sourceName: Kerala State Planning Board landslide report

incidents.title: Landslide on Munnar Ghat Road
incidents.description: Kerala State Planning Board's field report records a 2019 landslide at a second Munnar Ghat Road location.
incidents.sourceName: Kerala State Planning Board landslide report

incidents.title: Munnar Government College landslide
incidents.description: A landslide at the Government College Munnar site was documented in a Kerala State Planning Board field report. Drainage blockage and previous cracks were noted.
incidents.sourceName: Kerala State Planning Board landslide report

incidents.title: Landslide on Munnar Silent Valley Road
incidents.description: Kerala State Planning Board's field report records a 2019 landslide on Munnar Silent Valley Road; no casualty was reported in that entry.
incidents.sourceName: Kerala State Planning Board landslide report

incidents.title: Great Flood of 1924 and destruction of Munnar road
incidents.description: Kerala disaster-management/history sources document the 1924 flood and landslides around Karinthiri that destroyed the historic road connection to Munnar.
incidents.sourceName: Kerala State Disaster Management Authority / Kerala government sources

incidents.title: Major landslides and road damage in the Nilgiris
incidents.description: A peer-reviewed study documents major landslides in the Nilgiris in November 2009, including severe damage to the Mettupalayam-Coonoor-Ooty approach road.
